name: Baked Spaghetti Squash (Well-Cooked Soft Strands)
whyItWorks: Spaghetti squash halved, deseeded, and baked cut-side down until threads are completely soft. While a low-carb favorite, strands must be cooked thoroughly soft and chewed carefully.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Bake cut side down at 400°F for 45 minutes until rind gives easily when pressed. Scrape soft strands into a bowl and chop short with scissors before serving.
